title: Could Franklin Arias join Red Sox before end of 2026 season?
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Franklin Arias, Boston's No. 2 prospect, is batting .326 with 12 RBI in his first 10 games at Triple-A Worcester.
Red Sox's chief baseball officer Craig Breslow stresses focusing on Arias's development before considering a major league call-up.
Arias could debut if Trevor Story struggles post-injury and if Arias continues his strong performance in Worcester.

title: Police search for person they say broke into Jamaica Plain apartment, tried to pull blanket off sleeping victim
author: Audrey Cooney
bullets: Boston police are searching for a suspect who broke into a Jamaica Plain apartment on Heath Street around 7 a.m. on Aug. 5.
The suspect allegedly climbed through a bedroom window, attempted to pull a blanket off the sleeping victim, and then fled.
The suspect is described as a Black male in his late teens or early 20s wearing a white t-shirt and black and white cap.

title: Why did this part break so quickly on my 2023 pickup?
author: John Paul
bullets: A 2023 Ford Maverick's front sway bar links broke after 22,000 miles; consider warranty repair or aftermarket parts.
Torx-Plus fasteners provide a stronger, more precise fit compared to traditional Torx, beneficial for automated assembly.
CTEK and Deltran produce reliable trickle/maintainer chargers for vehicles, essential for maintaining battery health.

title: 5 takeaways from Jaylen Brown’s introductory press conference with 76ers
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Jaylen Brown held his first press conference as a Philadelphia 76er, expressing mixed emotions about leaving Boston.
Brown shared he hasn't communicated with Jayson Tatum since the trade, but respects their championship-winning partnership.
Despite a tense trade process, Brown expressed gratitude for his decade-long development and experiences in Boston.

title: 4 injured in Boston school bus rollover, police say
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Four adults sustained non-life-threatening injuries in a school bus rollover on 1000 Harvard St., Mattapan.
The incident occurred shortly before 1:10 p.m.; the cause of the rollover is still under investigation.
No children were on the bus, and injured victims were taken to a local hospital for treatment.

title: Drake Maye struggled during two-minute drill, and other takeaways from Day 11 of Patriots training camp
author: Khari A. Thompson
bullets: Drake Maye threw two interceptions during two-minute drills at Patriots training camp, ending a challenging day for the quarterback.
Marcus Bryant replaced injured left tackle Will Campbell during team drills, while first-round pick Caleb Lomu worked with the second team.
Christian Gonzalez and A.J. Brown showcased competitive play during drills, with both players testing each other for the coming season.

title: A beloved Cape Cod restaurant is closing after 21 years
author: Kristi Palma
bullets: Chach Restaurant in Provincetown will close on November 2 after 21 years, announced owners Viola Briseño and Sharon Bowes.
Briseño and Bowes, who opened Chach in 2005, have cooked everything from scratch, offering upscale comfort food.
Despite challenges like staffing and seasonality, Briseño and Bowes plan to remain in Provincetown after closing the restaurant.

title: The best movies on Netflix right now (August 2026)
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: Netflix features 'Clueless' (1995), a classic starring Alicia Silverstone, now available for streaming.
'Eighth Grade' (2018), directed by Bo Burnham, provides an honest portrayal of middle school anxiety and is now on Netflix.
'Inside Man' (2006), a re-watchable Spike Lee bank heist film starring Denzel Washington and Clive Owen, streams on Netflix.

title: Navy says it can’t help recover wreckage of Gloucester fishing boat Lily Jean
author: Beth Treffeisen
bullets: The US Navy declined to assist in recovering the wreckage of the fishing vessel Lily Jean near Gloucester.
Gov. Maura Healey requested help, hoping to recover data and remains from the January 2026 sinking.
The US Coast Guard and NTSB are leading the investigation, with no details on the cause of the sinking yet.

title: Councilor Flynn blocks measure calling for response to elimination of protected status for Haitians
author: Ross Cristantiello
bullets: Councilor Flynn blocked a resolution urging Boston to respond to the end of TPS protections for Haitians and Syrians.
The resolution by Councilor Louijeune aimed to coordinate support for TPS holders affected by potential deportation and job loss.
The measure will be reviewed by the Committee on Housing and Community Development after Flynn raised objections.
